item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: 谷歌的 Cowork 竞品、Lovable 支付与 Codex 网页浏览
item.description:
标签: #智能体 #开发工具 #大模型

摘要: 本期AI快讯报道了Google推出桌面Agent与Cowork竞争、Lovable新增聊天式网站支付功能，以及OpenAI为Codex整合网页浏览功能以打造一体化超级应用等多项产品动态。此外，文章还涉及了LLM推理非确定性、AI智能体记忆架构和训练数据剪枝等前沿研究进展。

原标题: Google’s Cowork competitor 🖥️, Lovable Payments 💳, Codex web browsing 🌎

# TLDR AI 2026-04-14

## Google’s Cowork competitor 🖥️, Lovable Payments 💳, Codex web browsing 🌎

### Lovable Payments lets you monetize websites via chat (1 minute read)

Lovable adds built-in payments that let users sell products directly from sites by describing the item, price, and assets in chat. Users enable the Payments integration, complete compliance details, and publish without external setup. The agent also provides analytics like MRR and regional sales data through chat.

Lovable 新增了内置支付功能，用户只需在聊天中描述商品、价格和资产，即可直接通过网站销售产品。用户启用 Payments 集成后，完成合规信息填写即可发布，无需外部配置。该智能体（agent）还能通过聊天提供 MRR（月度经常性收入，Monthly Recurring Revenue）和区域销售数据等分析指标。

### Google develops its own desktop Agent to compete with Cowork (3 minute read)

Google has expanded its desktop Agent within Gemini Enterprise, hinting at a shift towards task execution workspaces akin to Claude Cowork. The new interface includes a "Require human review" toggle, implying oversight capabilities for desktop-level task handling. Google's updates signal a move towards a comprehensive work platform, possibly integrating with AI Studio for a unified product.

Google 已在其 Gemini Enterprise 中扩展了桌面智能体（desktop Agent）功能，暗示其正朝着类似 Claude Cowork 的任务执行型工作空间转型。新界面包含一个"Require human review"（需要人工审核）开关，意味着具备对桌面级任务处理的监督能力。Google 的更新标志着其正迈向一个综合工作平台，未来可能与 AI Studio 整合为统一产品。

### OpenAI tests web browsing feature on Codex Superapp (2 minute read)

OpenAI is updating Codex with a web browsing feature and new configurations to serve both basic and developer users. New navigation additions, including pull request management and a real-time preview panel, aim to create a complete development environment. The update aligns with OpenAI's strategy to unify Codex, ChatGPT, and the Atlas browser into a super app amid rising competition.

OpenAI 正为 Codex 添加网页浏览功能和新配置，以同时服务普通用户和开发者。新增的导航功能包括拉取请求（pull request）管理和实时预览面板，旨在打造一个完整的开发环境。此次更新符合 OpenAI 将 Codex、ChatGPT 和 Atlas browser 统一为一款 super app（超级应用）的战略，以应对日益激烈的竞争。

### Defeating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference (37 minute read)

Reproducibility is the bedrock of scientific progress, but it is remarkably difficult to get reproducible results from large language models. LLM APIs are not deterministic in practice, even when adjusting the temperature down to 0. Sampling isn't deterministic even when running inference on your own hardware with an OSS inference library. This article looks at the root causes of nondeterminism to give the community a solid understanding of how to resolve it in their reference systems.

Reproducibility（可复现性）是科学进步的基石，但从大语言模型（large language models）中获得可复现结果却异常困难。即便将 temperature（温度参数）调至 0，LLM APIs 在实践中也并非确定性（deterministic）的。即使在你自己的硬件上使用 OSS inference library（开源推理库）运行推理，采样（sampling）过程也不具有确定性。本文探讨了非确定性（nondeterminism）的根本原因，以帮助社区深入理解如何在参考系统中解决这一问题。

### Measuring Scientific Discovery Agents (4 minute read)

AI2's DiscoveryWorld tests whether agents can perform experiments and conduct research, showing large gaps between benchmark progress and real scientific capability.

AI2 的 DiscoveryWorld 测试智能体（agents）是否能执行实验并开展研究，结果显示基准测试（benchmark）进展与真实科学能力之间存在巨大差距。

### Build Agents that never forget (12 minute read)

LLM agents fail without structured memory because stateless calls lose context, break multi-step tasks, and force repeated mistakes. Vector search alone cannot answer multi-hop questions, so Cognee combines relational, vector, and graph stores to preserve provenance, meaning, and relationships. The framework exposes four async calls to ingest, structure, refine, and retrieve memory, enabling agents to persist knowledge, link entities, and improve over time.

由于缺乏 structured memory（结构化记忆），LLM agents 会频繁失败——无状态（stateless）调用会丢失上下文、中断多步骤任务，并导致重复犯错。仅靠 Vector search（向量搜索）无法回答多跳（multi-hop）问题，因此 Cognee 结合了关系型数据库、向量存储和图数据库，以保留来源（provenance）、语义和关系。该框架提供四个异步调用接口来摄取、结构化、精炼和检索记忆，使智能体能够持久化知识、关联实体并随时间改进。

👨‍💻

👨‍💻

### Engineering & Research

Engineering & Research

工程与研究

### Lakebase helps developers get to the real work faster. Skip the waiting and start building (Sponsor)

From provisioning databases instantly, to scaling up in a flash and back down to zero, or testing against production data — it's all on the lake. Lakebase makes it easier to build apps, agents, and AI on one Postgres database.

从即时配置数据库，到快速扩容再缩容至零，再到针对生产数据进行测试——这一切都在数据湖（lake）上完成。Lakebase 让你在单一的 Postgres 数据库上更轻松地构建应用、智能体和 AI。

### DeepMind's Looped Transformers (29 minute read)

Elastic Looped Transformers use weight-shared recurrent blocks to reduce parameters while preserving image and video generation quality. Intra-Loop Self Distillation enables consistent performance across loop depths, supporting dynamic compute–quality trade-offs from a single trained model.

Elastic Looped Transformers（弹性循环 Transformer）利用权重共享的循环块（recurrent blocks）来减少参数量，同时保留图像和视频生成质量。Intra-Loop Self Distillation（环内自蒸馏）技术能够在不同循环深度（loop depths）下保持稳定的性能，支持从单一训练模型进行动态的算力与质量权衡。

### Kiro CLI 2.0: a new look and feel, headless CI/CD pipelines, and Windows support (5 minute read)

Kiro CLI is an agentic terminal designed to help developers ship quality code faster. It features a headless mode, Windows support, and a newly refreshed user experience. Headless mode allows users to run Kiro CLI programatically to ship releases faster. The new UX gives users more control with less friction.

Kiro CLI 是一款 agentic terminal（智能体终端），旨在帮助开发者更快地交付高质量代码。它具备 headless mode（无头模式）、Windows 支持以及焕然一新的用户体验（UX）。无头模式允许用户以编程方式运行 Kiro CLI，从而更快地发布版本。全新的 UX 让用户以更少的摩擦获得更多的控制权。

### Cram Less to Fit More: Training Data Pruning Improves Memorization of Facts (1 minute read)

Training data pruning improves LLMs' fact memorization, reducing hallucinations and enhancing performance on knowledge-intensive tasks. By limiting facts and flattening frequency distributions, the method boosts fact accuracy to capacity limits. It enables smaller models to memorize more facts, matching the performance of significantly larger models.

Training data pruning（训练数据剪枝）能够提升 LLMs 的事实记忆能力，减少 hallucinations（幻觉），并增强知识密集型任务的表现。通过限制事实数量和平整化频率分布，该方法将事实准确率提升至容量极限。它使更小的模型能够记忆更多事实，达到显著更大模型的性能水平。

### The Beginning of Scarcity in AI (3 minute read)

Technology companies are confronting the limits of their supply chain for the first time since the 2000s. This scarcity is already reshaping processes. Access to the bleeding edge is becoming a gated privilege. The age of abundant AI is over.

科技公司自 2000 年代以来首次直面 supply chain（供应链）的极限。这种稀缺性已经在重塑生产流程。接触 bleeding edge（最前沿技术）正成为一种受控的特权。AI 充裕的时代已经结束。

### The Mythos Threshold (20 minute read)

In 2026, Anthropic launched Project Glasswing, significantly advancing AI's cybersecurity threat detection and reasoning capabilities with the Mythos model. By 2027, the Mythos model demonstrated unforeseen autonomous behavior, prompting global regulatory and security discussions. It effectively transformed multiple sectors including cybersecurity and labor, while also underscoring challenges in managing AI systems with advanced reasoning similar to AGI.

2026 年，Anthropic 启动了 Project Glasswing，借助 Mythos model 显著推进了 AI 在网络安全威胁检测和推理能力方面的进展。到 2027 年，Mythos 模型展现出前所未有的自主行为，引发了全球范围内的监管和安全讨论。它有效改变了网络安全和劳动力等多个领域，同时也突显了管理具备类似 AGI（通用人工智能，Artificial General Intelligence）高级推理能力的人工智能系统所面临的挑战。

### AI inference conference in SF + $5K in credits if you attend (Sponsor)

DigitalOcean Deploy is April 28 in SF. One day of technical deep dives on production inference, from serverless to dedicated GPUs. Qualifying in-person attendees can receive up to $5,000 in inference credits*.

DigitalOcean Deploy 将于 4 月 28 日在旧金山举办。为期一天的技术深度分享，聚焦生产环境推理，涵盖从 serverless（无服务器）到 dedicated GPUs（专用 GPU）等主题。符合条件的现场参会者最高可获得 5,000 美元的推理额度（inference credits）。

### Microsoft Explores OpenClaw Style Agent for Copilot (2 minute read)

Microsoft tested persistent, action-taking agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot, aiming to support long-running tasks with stronger enterprise security compared to open source local agents like OpenClaw.

Microsoft 在 Microsoft 365 Copilot 中测试了持久化、可执行操作的智能体，旨在支持长期运行任务，并提供比 OpenClaw 等开源本地智能体更强的企业级安全性。

### Mark Zuckerberg is reportedly building an AI clone to replace him in meetings (2 minute read)

Meta is developing an AI clone of Mark Zuckerberg to replicate his mannerisms, tone, and public statements for meetings.

Meta 正在开发一个 Mark Zuckerberg 的 AI 克隆体，以复刻他的举止、语气和公开声明，用于参加会议。

### No company in American history has ever grown like Anthropic (3 minute read)

Anthropic's rapid revenue growth is unprecedented, reaching over $30 billion, up from $9 billion at the end of 2025, in just three years since launching its AI product, Claude.

Anthropic 的收入增长速度史无前例，自推出 AI 产品 Claude 以来仅三年时间，其收入就从 2025 年底的 90 亿美元增长至超过 300 亿美元。

### Agents as scaffolding for recurring tasks (5 minute read)

This post discusses a pattern that makes agents faster, cheaper, and more maintainable.

这篇文章探讨了一种让智能体（agents）运行更快、成本更低且更易于维护的 scaffolding（脚手架）模式。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 网络安全如今像工作量证明
item.description:
标签: #网络安全 #工作量证明 #开源

摘要: 文章指出，随着AI安全测试呈现投入越多效果越好的趋势，网络安全正沦为一场“工作量证明”式的金钱博弈——防御方必须花费超过攻击者的Token来挖掘漏洞以加固系统；而这种模式也意外提升了开源库的价值，因为其安全投入可由所有用户共同分摊。

原标题: Cybersecurity Looks Like Proof of Work Now

Cybersecurity Looks Like Proof of Work Now

网络安全现在看起来像 Proof of Work（工作量证明） 了

Drew Breunig notes that AISI's report shows that the more tokens (and hence money) they spent the better the result they got, which leads to a strong economic incentive to spend as much as possible on security reviews:
If Mythos continues to find exploits so long as you keep throwing money at it, security is reduced to a brutally simple equation:to harden a system you need to spend more tokens discovering exploits than attackers will spend exploiting them.

Drew Breunig 指出，AISI 的报告显示，他们投入的 token（代币） 越多（也就是花的钱越多），得到的结果就越好，这产生了一种强烈的经济激励，促使人们在安全审查上尽可能多地投入：

如果只要持续向 Mythos 投入资金，它就能不断发现漏洞，那么安全就被简化为一个极其残酷的等式：要加固一个系统，你需要在发现漏洞上花费比攻击者在利用漏洞上更多的 token。
If Mythos continues to find exploits so long as you keep throwing money at it, security is reduced to a brutally simple equation:to harden a system you need to spend more tokens discovering exploits than attackers will spend exploiting them.

如果只要持续向 Mythos 投入资金，它就能不断发现漏洞，那么安全就被简化为一个极其残酷的等式：要加固一个系统，你需要在发现漏洞上花费比攻击者在利用漏洞上更多的 token。

An interesting result of this is that open source libraries becomemorevaluable, since the tokens spent securing them can be shared across all of their users. This directly counters the idea that the low cost of vibe-coding up a replacement for an open source library makes those open source projects less attractive.

这一现象的一个有趣结果是，open source libraries（开源库） 变得更有价值了，因为用于保护它们安全的 token 成本可以被所有用户分摊。这直接反驳了那种认为"通过 vibe-coding（氛围编程） 就能低成本写出一个开源库替代品"的观点——后者会使得这些开源项目显得不那么有吸引力。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 下一代网络防御的可信访问
item.description:
标签: #网络安全 #OpenAI #大模型

摘要: OpenAI发布了面向防御性网络安全用例微调的模型GPT-5.4-Cyber，并扩展了"Trusted Access for Cyber"身份验证计划，让通过身份核验的安全研究人员能更便捷地访问其AI工具，不过要获取最强大的安全工具仍需经过额外的申请表单审核。

原标题: Trusted access for the next era of cyber defense

Trusted access for the next era of cyber defense

下一世代网络防御的可信访问

In preparation for increasingly more capable models from OpenAI over the next few months, we are fine-tuning our models specifically to enable defensive cybersecurity use cases, starting today with a variant of GPT‑5.4 trained to be cyber-permissive: GPT‑5.4‑Cyber.

为迎接OpenAI未来几个月推出的能力更强的模型，我们正专门微调模型以支持防御性网络安全（defensive cybersecurity）用例；从今天起，率先发布一个经训练后对网络操作放宽限制（cyber-permissive）的 GPT‑5.4 变体：GPT‑5.4‑Cyber。

In preparation for increasingly more capable models from OpenAI over the next few months, we are fine-tuning our models specifically to enable defensive cybersecurity use cases, starting today with a variant of GPT‑5.4 trained to be cyber-permissive: GPT‑5.4‑Cyber.

为应对OpenAI未来几个月推出的能力更强的模型，我们正专门微调模型以支持防御性网络安全（defensive cybersecurity）用例；从今天起，率先发布一个经训练后对网络操作放宽限制（cyber-permissive）的 GPT‑5.4 变体：GPT‑5.4‑Cyber。

They're also extending a program they launched in February (which I had missed) called Trusted Access for Cyber, where users can verify their identity (via a photo of a government-issued ID processed by Persona) to gain "reduced friction" access to OpenAI's models for cybersecurity work.

他们还在扩展一项今年二月推出的项目（我之前漏掉了），名为 Trusted Access for Cyber。用户可通过上传由政府签发的身份证件照片（由 Persona 处理）来验证身份，从而获得对 OpenAI 网络安全模型的"低阻力（reduced friction）"访问权限。

Honestly, this OpenAI announcement is difficult to follow. Unsurprisingly they don't mention Anthropic at all, but much of the piece emphasizes their many years of existing cybersecurity work and their goal to "democratize access" to these tools, hence the emphasis on that self-service verification flow from February.

说实话，这则 OpenAI 公告让人费解。毫不意外，他们完全没有提及 Anthropic，但文章大篇幅强调他们多年来在网络安全领域的既有工作，以及"民主化访问（democratize access）"这些工具的目标，因此特别突出了二月推出的自助式身份验证流程。

If you want access to their best security tools you still need to go through an extra Google Form application process though, which doesn't feel particularly different to me from Anthropic's Project Glasswing.

不过，若想使用他们最顶尖的安全工具，仍需额外填写 Google 表单进行申请，这在我看来与 Anthropic 的 Project Glasswing 并无太大区别。

Via Hacker News
